Diamonds & Gemstones

Diamonds & Gemstones

Part of Al Sheikh Investment Group

Our diamonds and gemstones business focuses on sourcing and refining precious stones. Emeralds are a particular specialism, with sources in Colombia, Zambia, Brazil and Pakistan.

From the character of a rough stone to the finish of a polished emerald, our team places quality and authenticity at the centre of every conversation.
